    if (graph == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("graph must not be null");
    if (tour == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("tour must not be null");
    if (tour.isEmpty()) {
        // return empty path
        return new GraphPath<>(graph, null, null, Collections.emptyList(), 0.0);
    }
    Map<E, Boolean> used = new HashMap<>();
    List<E> orderedEdges = new ArrayList<>(tour.size());
    List<V> vertices = new ArrayList<>(tour.size()+1);
    Iterator<E> eIter = tour.iterator();
    E first = eIter.next();
    used.put(first, true);
    orderedEdges.add(first);
    V start = graph.getEdgeSource(first);
    V current = graph.getEdgeTarget(first);
    vertices.add(start);
    vertices.add(current);

    double totalWeight = graph.getEdgeWeight(first);

    // Build adjacency map for quick lookup: vertex -> list of incident edges
    // However we just need to find next edge each step. We'll check all edges in tour until find not used and incident to current.
    while (orderedEdges.size() < tour.size()) {

            V source = graph.getEdgeSource(e);
            V target = graph.getEdgeTarget(e);

                orderedEdges.add(e);
                // move to other vertex
                V next = source.equals(current) ? target : source;
                vertices.add(next);
                totalWeight += graph.getEdgeWeight(e);
                current = next;
                found = true;
                break;

        }
        if (!found) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Input set does not form a continuous tour");
        }

    // We can create GraphPath across orderedEdges with start and end vertices
    return new GraphPath<>(graph, start, current, orderedEdges, totalWeight);
}

private boolean isConnected(int source, int target, Set<Integer> removed) {
    Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    visited.add(source);
    q.add(source);
    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
        int cur = q.poll();
        if (cur == target) return true;
        for (E e : graph.edgesOf(cur)) {
            int neighbor = graph.getEdgeSource(e) == cur ? graph.getEdgeTarget(e) : graph.getEdgeSource(e);
            if (removed.contains(neighbor) || visited.contains(neighbor)) continue;
            visited.add(neighbor);
            q.add(neighbor);
        }
    }
    return false;
}
